title: Bibimbap with beef, vegetables and egg
steps: Wash the rice and cook it covered with 170 ml water for 12 minutes.
Cut the beef into thin strips and marinate with soy sauce, garlic and 1 tsp sesame oil.
Blanch the spinach and sprouts for 1 minute each, cut the carrot into strips and slice the mushrooms, then stir-fry each briefly.
Sear the beef for 2–3 minutes, then fry the eggs.
Put the rice in bowls, arrange the vegetables, beef and egg on top, add gochujang and sesame and mix before eating.
